name: Bastien Aubert
source:
“Even I must be bound by bonds of duty and reason.”
The shy, soft-hearted son of your mother’s loyal Steward, Bastien is eager to prove himself to his father, your household and most of all himself. He will do anything he can to help you win, though he will probably be nervous about a lot of it.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=40623]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
